name: stress-ng fp
description: Start N workers that exercise addition, multiplication and division operations on a range of floating point types. For each type, 8 floating point values are operated upon 65536 times in a loop per bogo op. The score is the total bogo operations per second (in real time) based on wall clock run time.

environment_fields.measured_at: Timestamp (UTC) of finishing the benchmark run.
environment_fields.kernel_version: Linux kernel version of the server running the benchmark (not recorded for managed databases).
